benchmark.scope_note: TensorRT end_to_end includes host/device transfers and output materialization; model_only starts from a prepared CUDA tensor.

decision.reason: Native TensorRT adoption requires the fixed-seed correctness gates and a measured batch=1 end-to-end P95 improvement over the ORT CUDA FP32 baseline; model size is secondary.

installation_complexity.assessment: additional isolated TensorRT dependency and explicit site-packages wiring

maintenance.assessment: keep as an optional native artifact; do not add it to the Browser deployment path

portability.assessment: rebuild and revalidate for a different GPU or software stack

technical_question: Can TensorRT build a correct, useful batch=1 engine for the canonical Breakout policy on this NVIDIA GPU?
